name: Thunder
look: Thunder shield from cultivation fantasy. A sphere of crackling purple-white lightning surrounds the character, jagged arcs crawling over its surface.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the lightning sphere alone, its surface and arcs, no glow
forms: collapsed to half its size, bright

parts.name: ARC
parts.text: one jagged lightning arc alone, branching

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: electric sparks, a flash star, a small forked bolt

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the sphere and its arcs, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: sparks gather round the character and snap together into the crackling sphere
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: arcs crawl and flicker over the sphere's surface in different places each frame; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow comes from the right; a thick bolt of lightning arcs out from the sphere to the right and strikes back at it, a white flash at the contact

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the sphere collapses inward into a last bright flash and a few fading sparks
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
